name: Book

fields.name: isbn
fields.description: International Standard Book Number - unique identifier for the book

fields.name: title
fields.description: The title of the book

fields.name: author
fields.description: The author(s) of the book

fields.name: category
fields.description: Genre or category classification (e.g., Fiction, Science, History)

fields.name: availabilityStatus
fields.description: Current status of the book: 'available', 'checked_out', or 'reserved'

fields.name: publicationYear
fields.description: Year the book was published

fields.name: dateAdded
fields.description: Date when the book was added to the library collection

description: Represents books in the library collection with details like title, author, ISBN, category, and current availability status

name: Member

fields.name: membershipId
fields.description: Unique membership identification number

fields.name: fullName
fields.description: Full name of the library member

fields.name: email
fields.description: Email address for member communication

fields.name: phone
fields.description: Contact phone number

fields.name: membershipStatus
fields.description: Current status of membership (active, suspended, expired)

fields.name: joinDate
fields.description: Date when member joined the library

fields.name: expiryDate
fields.description: Date when membership expires

description: Represents library members with personal details, contact information, and membership status

name: Reservation

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the reservation

fields.name: bookId
fields.description: Reference to the reserved book

fields.name: memberId
fields.description: Reference to the member making the reservation

fields.name: reservationDate
fields.description: Date and time when the reservation was placed

fields.name: queuePosition
fields.description: Position in the reservation queue for this book

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current status of reservation (pending, ready, fulfilled, cancelled, expired)

fields.name: expiryDate
fields.description: Date when the reservation expires if not picked up (when status is ready)

indexes.description: Optimize queue position lookups for specific books

constraints.validStatus: Status must be one of: pending, ready, fulfilled, cancelled, expired
constraints.queuePositionPositive: Queue position must be a positive integer
constraints.uniqueActiveReservation: A member cannot have multiple active reservations for the same book

description: Manages book reservations for items currently unavailable, tracking queue position and priority order

relationships.description: Each reservation is for one book
Each reservation belongs to one member

name: Transaction

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the transaction

fields.name: memberId
fields.description: Reference to the member who borrowed the book

fields.name: bookId
fields.description: Reference to the borrowed book

fields.name: checkoutDate
fields.description: Date when the book was checked out

fields.name: dueDate
fields.description: Date when the book is due for return

fields.name: returnDate
fields.description: Actual date when the book was returned (null if not yet returned)

fields.name: lateFee
fields.description: Calculated late fee amount in currency units

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current status of the transaction (checked_out, returned, overdue)

indexes.description: Index for quick lookup of member transaction history
Index for tracking book borrowing history
Index for filtering transactions by status

constraints.validStatus: status must be one of: checked_out, returned, overdue
constraints.nonNegativeFee: lateFee must be greater than or equal to 0
constraints.returnAfterCheckout: returnDate must be after checkoutDate if set

description: Records book borrowing transactions including checkout, returns, and late fees for library members

relationships.description: Each transaction belongs to one member
Each transaction is associated with one book
